def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    n = len(customers)
    if n == 0:
        return []

    # Helpers
    def route_load(rt):
        s = 0
        for v in rt:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for rt in routes:
            s += route_cost(rt)
        return s

    def feasible_append(route, node):
        # route is list, we only append at end; caller ensures capacity
        return

    def best_insertion_for_route(routes, rt_index, node, best_score_global):
        # Try inserting node into route position that yields minimal increase; return best (pos, inc)
        rt = routes[rt_index]
        L = len(rt)
        # route cost baseline
        base = 0
        if L == 0:
            base = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
            return 0, base  # insert at pos 0
        base = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(L - 1):
            base += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]

        # Compute delta for inserting between i-1 and i
        best_pos = None
        best_delta = None
        # pos means insert at index pos (0..L)
        for pos in range(L + 1):
            if pos == 0:
                a = depot
                b = rt[0]
                new_cost = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b]
                delta = new_cost - (matrix[a][b])
            elif pos == L:
                a = rt[-1]
                b = depot
                new_cost = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b]
                delta = new_cost - (matrix[a][b])
            else:
                a = rt[pos - 1]
                b = rt[pos]
                new_cost = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b]
                delta = new_cost - (matrix[a][b])
            if best_pos is None or (delta < best_delta) or (delta == best_delta and pos < best_pos):
                best_pos = pos
                best_delta = delta
        return best_pos, best_delta

    # Initial solution: Clarke-Wright savings with deterministic merge rules
    # Build single-customer routes
    unassigned = set(customers)
    routes = []
    route_index = {}  # customer -> route index
    for v in customers:
        if v not in unassigned:
            continue
        routes.append([v])
        route_index[v] = len(routes) - 1
        unassigned.remove(v)

    # capacity feasibility guard (should be always possible for instances; if not, still place but later will fail)
    # compute savings list
    # Savings s(i,j) = d(depot,i) + d(depot,j) - d(i,j)
    savings = []
